author: NotCorgan
description: The Mycelium Abyss: a fungal zone reachable from the Act 1 and Act 2 obelisks, with spore-themed enemies, a scripted three-phase boss, the Morel the Myceliumancer hero (Spore Rot and Symbiosis auras, perks, 27 cards, 8 equipment pieces, 2 pets, cardbacks), events, loot, shops and a quest chain.
